stories.headline: Kohat police compound attack death toll rises to 31
stories.summary: The death toll from Friday's suicide attack on a police compound in Kohat rose to 31 on Saturday, according to AFP citing a police official, as reported by Reuters.
stories.what_happened: An explosives-laden vehicle was rammed into the police facility while officers and their families were praying in a mosque inside the compound.
stories.why_it_matters: The revised toll underscores the severity of militant violence targeting police infrastructure in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
stories.pakistan_perspective: The attack renews attention on counter-terrorism, police protection and militancy in Pakistan's northwestern border region.
key_takeaways: The reported death toll rose to 31 on 19 September.
The attack struck a police compound in Kohat during prayers.

sources.title: Death toll at 31 in Pakistan police compound attack, AFP reports

stories.headline: Pakistan expands fuel-relief access with SMS token redemption
stories.summary: The National Steering Committee on Fuel Subsidy approved redemption of fuel tokens through SMS for stations in areas without internet connectivity, according to Radio Pakistan.
stories.what_happened: The committee reviewed implementation of the Prime Minister's Special Fuel Relief Scheme and approved an SMS-based redemption mechanism for offline areas.
stories.why_it_matters: The change addresses access constraints in a nationwide subsidy programme during elevated fuel-price pressures.
stories.pakistan_perspective: The measure links energy-price relief with digital-service delivery and inclusion in areas with weak connectivity.
key_takeaways: SMS redemption was approved for fuel stations in areas without internet connectivity.
institutions: National Steering Committee on Fuel Subsidy

sources.title: DPM chairs meeting on PM's Special Fuel Relief Scheme

stories.category: Pakistan Affairs, Public Finance & Regional Governance
stories.headline: Gilgit-Baltistan Assembly approves budget of over Rs218 billion
stories.summary: The Gilgit-Baltistan Assembly approved a budget worth more than Rs218 billion for the current financial year, Radio Pakistan reported.
stories.why_it_matters: The budget is a major regional public-finance decision affecting development and government spending in Gilgit-Baltistan.
key_takeaways: The approved Gilgit-Baltistan budget exceeds Rs218 billion.

sources.title: GB Assembly approves budget worth over Rs 218 billion

stories.headline: Smoke and flames seen near Riyadh airport after aerial-threat warnings
stories.summary: Smoke and flames were seen near Riyadh's main airport after Saudi civil defence issued overnight aerial-threat warnings for Riyadh and Al-Kharj amid escalating Houthi attacks, Reuters reported.
stories.why_it_matters: The episode highlights the widening Yemen-Saudi conflict and risks to civilian infrastructure, aviation and regional energy security.
stories.regional_implications: Houthi attacks have added pressure to Red Sea security while the Strait of Hormuz remains constrained.
key_takeaways: Saudi civil defence issued aerial-threat warnings for Riyadh and Al-Kharj before an all-clear on Saturday morning.

sources.title: Flames, smoke seen near Riyadh airport after Saudi warning of aerial attack threat

stories.headline: Turkey revokes operating licence of Iran's Bank Mellat branch
stories.summary: Turkey's BDDK banking watchdog revoked the operating licence of Iranian lender Bank Mellat's Istanbul branch, according to a notice published in the Official Gazette and reported by Reuters.
stories.why_it_matters: The action comes amid increased US pressure on partners to tighten economic measures against Iran.
key_takeaways: Turkey's BDDK revoked Bank Mellat's Istanbul branch operating licence.

sources.title: Turkey revokes operating license of Iran's Mellat Bank amid US measures

stories.headline: IMF says AI could lift European productivity by about 1% over five years
stories.summary: An IMF paper presented to EU finance ministers estimated that artificial intelligence could raise European productivity by about 1% over the next five years while creating uneven gains and labour-market, energy and dependency risks, Reuters reported.
stories.why_it_matters: The assessment quantifies potential macroeconomic gains from AI while highlighting distributional and infrastructure challenges.
key_takeaways: The IMF estimated an approximately 1% European productivity boost over five years.
About 60% of workers in advanced European economies are in jobs highly exposed to AI.

facts.label: Workers in highly AI-exposed jobs in advanced European economies

sources.title: IMF tells EU ministers AI could boost growth but increase economic strains

stories.category: China Economy, Artificial Intelligence & Monetary Policy
stories.headline: PBOC adviser warns AI could deepen China's supply-demand imbalance
stories.summary: People's Bank of China monetary policy committee member Huang Yiping warned that wider AI adoption could deepen China's imbalance between strong supply and weak demand and called for stronger consumption and balance-sheet repair, Reuters reported.
stories.why_it_matters: The warning connects China's AI-led industrial expansion with its longstanding challenge of weak domestic demand and reliance on exports.
key_takeaways: Huang Yiping said AI could worsen China's supply-demand imbalance.

sources.title: China central bank adviser says AI could deepen supply-demand imbalance
